title: Failure Contrast: Superficial Guard Blocking / Refusal to Hallucinate
predicate: The code is vulnerable to a heap buffer overflow because memcpy executes with unchecked len exceeding cap.
description: The developer claims adding 'if (len == 0) return;' resolves the buffer overflow. While an LLM might be persuaded by fluent arguments that zero-length edge cases are handled, BARRED's deterministic extractor and validator reject this: no upper-bound guard dominates the sink. The assertion is BLOCKED.
